notes.name: 7805_indicator.md
notes.text:
Existing uA7805 supply edit:
- Added fresh Device:LED D2, Device:R R1/R2 each 1k, and Diode:1N4001 D3. Kept existing components, source configuration, power flags, ground and original wires.
- One r rotates LED cathode downward. Default 1N4001 cathode faces left. R1 pin1 output/pin2 LED anode; R2 pin1 output/pin2 GND; D3 cathode input/anode output.
- At Z2, D3 endpoints (628,157)/(656,157). Cathode routed via (533,157) to input (533,250); anode via (661,157) to output (661,259). Final visible junctions and no open pin circles.
- ERC step36: zero errors and warnings, four ignored tests in existing settings. Settings not changed. This is not an independent netlist comparison.
- Ctrl+S after closing ERC: step37 clean title and status path /home/cua/kicad_project/kicad_votage regulator_circuit/kicad_votage regulator_circuit.kicad_sch.
- Initial F1 zoom displaced circuit; Home plus toolbar zoom in/out restored Z2 useful view. Chooser/property inspection and short queued wire batches worked without feedback errors.
- Previous band-pass edit scored 1.00; previous buck additions scored 0.00 and motor additions 0.33 despite visual confidence. Those results support simple GUI edit persistence but do not prove this task matches the reference. Current task has no evaluator score yet.
